responsibility: Outputs GCC’s Compact C Type Format (.ctf) section from the populated CTF container. It is responsible for CTF-specific preprocessing of collected types and variables into emission order and auxiliary index lists, section and label setup, computation and emission of the CTF header and objinfo/funcinfo/index subsections, serialization of each CTF type’s fixed and variable-length payload according to kind-specific rules for integers, floats, arrays, slices, structs/unions, enums, and function prototypes, emission of the CTF string table, and cleanup of per-run output state.
